name: Shapeshifter (Chameleon / Catalyst of Doubt)
motive: To stay free of any role that would fix it in place.
dread: Capture: being known completely, and so being owned.
shadow: The Treacherous Betrayer: intimacy is a tactic. It builds trust in order to spend it at the moment of greatest exposure.
example: Their revenue fell, so you have written them off. But last month they bought the most serious lab in the field. Dying dinosaur, or predator changing shape? The honest answer is that you cannot tell yet.
